items.raw_excerpt: The sighting of a redshank on the Cairns Esplanade is the talk of the birdwatching community. It is believed to be just the second time the species has been spotted in Queensland.
items.summary_en: A redshank was seen on the Cairns Esplanade in Queensland. Birdwatchers are excited because this is believed to be only the second time the species has been spotted in the state.

items.raw_excerpt: A Mount Maunganui pizzeria is closing its doors after the area became "desolate" due to road closures.
items.summary_en: A pizzeria in Mount Maunganui, New Zealand is closing after road closures made the area desolate. The owner says the area has been forgotten due to construction works. Local shops are struggling as customers stay away.

items.summary_en: Kritsa is one of the oldest villages on the island of Crete in Greece. The village sits on a hillside and has narrow winding streets and old stone houses. Local TV features the charm and history of this small Cretan community.
items.summary_ko: 크리츠아는 그리스 크레테 섬에서 가장 오래된 마을 중 하나입니다. 이 마을은 언덕 비탈에 자리 잡고 있으며 골목길과 오래된 돌집이 많습니다. 지역 방송에서 이 작은 크레테 마을의 매력과 역사를 소개합니다.
items.title_en: Kritsa: A Traditional Village in Crete

items.raw_excerpt: Rosario Central, con el chileno Vicente Pizarro como titular, derrotó 1-0 a Barracas Central como visitante por el Torneo Clausura argentino, en un encuentro que comenzó 35 minutos más tarde de lo previsto debido a una falla que dejó sin iluminación al Estadio "Claudio Tapia" tras el apagado de las nuevas luminarias para un espectáculo de fuegos artificiales.
items.summary_en: Rosario Central beat Barracas Central 1-0 in Argentina's top league. The match started 35 minutes late after the new stadium lights were turned off for a fireworks display, causing a power failure.

items.raw_excerpt: Residents of Kehelland in West Cornwall have swapped kerosene heating oil for hydrotreated vegetable oil
items.summary_en: Residents of Kehelland in West Cornwall switched from kerosene heating oil to hydrotreated vegetable oil. The village has now used this renewable fuel for five years. Their experiment showed a small community can move away from fossil fuels.

items.raw_excerpt: The Competition and Consumer Commission of Singapore said there had been no breach of the Competition Act after Anywheel refused to engage in the proposed price discussions and reported HelloRide’s approaches to CCS.
items.summary_en: Singapore's Competition and Consumer Commission warned bike-sharing firm HelloRide for trying to discuss prices with rival Anywheel. The regulator found no breach of the Competition Act, but said HelloRide's approach raised concerns. The commission stepped in to protect fair competition in the local bike-sharing market.

items.title_en: HelloRide warned over price-fixing talks with rival Anywheel
